links.outcome: Readability of LLM prostate cancer answers (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level)
links.effect: Bard had the simplest output, with the highest FRE of 54.7 and the lowest FK grade level of 10.2 (both p < 0.001). Even the most readable output sits at roughly a 10th-grade level.
links.quote: For readability, Bard generated simpler sentences with the highest FRE score (54.7, p < 0.001) and lowest FK reading level (10.2, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability of three commercial LLMs answering prostate cancer patient questions, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
